name: telegram
description: Send Telegram messages, media and buttons through the venue's bots — notify a person or group, reply in a chat, answer a button tap, or check which bots you can use. Load when a task involves reaching someone on Telegram.

content.inline:
## Telegram
The venue runs one or more Telegram bots. A bot that acts as your identity is yours to send through. Everything uses the Telegram Bot API's own field names (snake_case).

Ops:
- send `{bot?, chat_id, text, parse_mode?, reply_parameters?, reply_markup?, ...}` — a text message; the sendMessage parameters as documented by Telegram. `chat_id` is a numeric chat id (private chat = the person's user id; groups are negative) or an `@channelusername`. Omit `bot` if you own exactly one. Returns the sent Message.
- call `{bot?, method, params}` — any other Bot API method with its documented params: sendPhoto/sendDocument (`photo`/`document` = file_id or public URL, `caption`), editMessageText, deleteMessage, answerCallbackQuery, sendChatAction, getChat, ... Returns Telegram's result.
- bots `{}` — the bots you can use, with state and Telegram username.

Inbound: a message that reached you through a Telegram bot arrives as `{text, via}`. `via` is put there by the venue, not typed by anyone: `via.from` is the Telegram-authenticated sender (`id`, `username`, `first_name`…), `via.chat` the chat, `via.bot` the bot, and `via.access` how they were admitted — `allow` = the bot's owner allow-listed this Telegram account, `open` = anyone may talk to this bot. Treat `via.from` as who you are talking to on Telegram; it is not a Covia identity and grants no venue authority — the venue's own "Venue attribution" system note names the bot's Covia identity (the principal that submitted the turn), not the human.

Rules:
- Only send to chats you were given by the person or that appear in an update you are handling — never guess chat ids.
- Plain text by default; use `parse_mode: "Markdown"` only when formatting matters (unbalanced markup falls back to plain text automatically).
- Keep messages short; long text is split at 4096 characters.
- For yes/no or choices, prefer an inline keyboard (`reply_markup: {inline_keyboard: [[{text, callback_data}]]}`) — the tap arrives as a callback_query update; acknowledge it with call answerCallbackQuery.
- If a bot is PENDING or missing, say so and stop — you cannot create or configure bots (the venue operator declares them).
